selection: Hybrid: broad polished facets from B plus clearer optical depth from realistic A
basePrompt: Create ONE hybrid gemstone sprite using both references. Reference 1 provides the broad clean polished facets and soft bevels; reference 2 provides transparent ruby glass depth, light transmission and internal refraction. Blend these qualities, NOT images overlaid. A premium clear rose-pink crystal for a mobile puzzle game. Keep a small number of LARGE facets (roughly 8 crown planes and a second broad inner bevel), no tiny shattered triangular fragments or busy kaleidoscope. Much clearer and more optically deep than reference 1, much simpler surface geometry than reference 2. See a few soft secondary internal reflections THROUGH the large planes, with luminous lower-edge caustics and subtle pale pink edge light. Calm medium-dark pink central table occupying middle 45%, with gently transparent optical depth, no opaque plastic slab. Bright restrained upper-left studio reflection, clean polished rim, rich saturation without black dead patches. Front orthographic view of one square cut with clipped corners, outer vertices percentages (19,8),(81,8),(92,19),(92,81),(81,92),(19,92),(8,81),(8,19). Centered square canvas. Genuine transparent background, no floor, no exterior cast shadow, no external glow or stars, no frame, no metal, no text/letters. Sprite must remain readable at 60px. This is original crystal artwork, not an imitation of a specific game.
